items.label: Capture the source-docs subgroup boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: Record the semantic subgroup split before real FlowDoc lanes use focused Project Control checks.
items.verificationNote: PLAN accepted the subgroup direction: keep source-docs as the umbrella and split focused scripts into core-migration, live-draft, template-builder, text-block, and text-engine so a lane can choose the smallest relevant source-docs gate.

items.label: Write a failing source-docs subgroup guard.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused guard fails before subgroup scripts, default group IDs, subgroup IDs, and umbrella membership exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/project-control-test-groups.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because package.json did not define test:source-docs:* scripts and tools/lib/test-groups.ts did not export defaultTestGroupIds or sourceDocsSubgroupIds.

items.label: Add focused source-docs subgroup scripts.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control package scripts and test group definitions expose focused source-docs gates while preserving source-docs as the umbrella group.
items.verificationNote: package.json now exposes test:source-docs:core-migration, test:source-docs:live-draft, test:source-docs:template-builder, test:source-docs:text-block, and test:source-docs:text-engine. tools/lib/test-groups.ts keeps source-docs as an includeGroupIds umbrella and assigns files only to focused source-docs leaf groups.

items.label: Verify every focused source-docs subgroup.
items.evidenceTarget: Each focused source-docs subgroup script passes independently.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence: test:source-docs:core-migration passed 5 files / 66 tests; test:source-docs:live-draft passed 4 files / 22 tests; test:source-docs:template-builder passed 4 files / 28 tests; test:source-docs:text-block passed 4 files / 18 tests; test:source-docs:text-engine passed 4 files / 49 tests.

items.label: Verify source-docs umbrella and unit gate.
items.evidenceTarget: The source-docs umbrella and default unit gate still cover the full Project Control unit surface without duplicate subgroup runs.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence: npm run test:source-docs passed 21 files / 183 tests, and npm run test:unit ran records, source-docs umbrella, and app in default group order.

items.label: Record Project Control source-docs subgroup evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Phase, Checklist, Evidence, and Work required evidence for source-docs subgroup routing.
items.verificationNote: Registered phase-agent-and-skill-design-source-docs-subgroups, checklist-agent-and-skill-design-source-docs-subgroups, evidence-flowdoc-source-docs-subgroups-2026-09-03, and updated agent-and-skill-design requiredEvidence, summary, expectedOutput, and riskSummary.

items.label: Verify the source-docs subgroup evidence guard.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused evidence guard, generated read model, data validation, and full Project Control check gate pass.
